text:
jamie: quick async check-in — kernel/batching/KV perf
jamie: what I did: landed the kernel backpressure tweak (commit 9a4f2c), added per-model batching window config, and ran a lightweight perf sweep on small-L models.
jamie: blocker: seeing KV cache miss spike when concurrent seq-lengths vary a lot — need to confirm if it's eviction policy or warmup scheduling.
jamie: today: iterate on eviction heuristic and open PR for batching-window defaults; will ping for reviews.
ryan: nice. can you paste the perf numbers you got? curious about tail p99.
jamie: sure — overall token/s up ~6% on small-L. p50 improved ~9%, p99 unchanged (~480ms). KV miss rate jumped from 3.2% -> 8.7% under mixed seqlen workload.
maria: thx. for KV miss: did you test with the new async-prefetch enabled? that changed cache timing in my run.
jamie: yep, async-prefetch on. suspecting prefetch scheduling collides with eviction during bursts.
sasha: quick thought — maybe we should bias eviction to evict cold entries older than X requests rather than LRU solely. that would help when many short seqs crowd out long ones.
kevin: +1 to adding an age component. also can we surface eviction age in the runtime metrics? useful for tracing regressions.
jamie: good call — I'll add a metric: kv.eviction_age_histogram and kv.evictions_by_age_bucket. low cost.
perf-bot: benchmark result for thread 2467890123: workload=mixed-seqlen, stddev=3.1%, token/s=+5.8%, p50=+8.9%, p95=+2.1%, p99=0.0% (480ms). artifacts: https://perf.internal/runs/2467890123
ryan: thanks perf-bot. jamie — can you drop the PR link when ready? I'll do a quick review tomorrow morning.
jamie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321
jamie: note in the PR description I added a reproducer script and a simple log line to show eviction_reason on each evict.
maria: quick review note — the reproducer uses --concurrency=64 by default; could you add a smaller default (16) for dev runs so CI isn't noisy?
jamie: will change to 16, good catch.
sasha: also add a unit test for the age-biasing comparator; caught a corner once where age ties caused non-determinism.
kevin: if you want, I can help add the metrics dashboard panels after the PR merges.
jamie: that would be awesome. blocker for me: still want to confirm if eviction bias fixes miss rate under heavy mix. trying an AB with age_bias=0.2 vs 0.0 now.
jamie: quick status update after 30m AB: age_bias=0.2 reduced miss rate to ~4.1% and p99 dropped to 430ms. sending full logs to the perf run.
ryan: great signal. sounds promising. i'm ok to review once you trim the reproducer and add test.
maria: thanks everyone. for today's plan: i'll finish the canary rollout for the new batcher heuristics and monitor error budget; will post any anomalies in #eng-runtime-incidents.
jamie: cool — tagging @ryan for review when PR updated. anyone else with quick blockers?
kevin: none from infra side. will prep dashboard changes.
sasha: none here. :thumbsup:
jamie: ok wrapping up this async — will push PR changes in ~1.5h and post follow-up metrics. thanks all!
